description_en: Queries the downstream instances of a specified instance
description_zh: 根据起始的实例查询该实例的下游
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public get-instance-down-stream --op-tenant-id 30001011 --instance-get InstanceId=t_5929472_20210411_9577721 NodeType=DATA_PROCESS --run-status SUCCESS --down-stream-depth 1 --env PROD --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceDownStream
